description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class for the installer interface of the OrangeHRM application, providing common functionality for rendering installer-related views, managing templates, components, and context data, and handling different installer and upgrader screens.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerVueController
classes.description: An abstract controller class for managing installer and upgrader Vue.js views, handling template rendering, context management, and screen navigation.

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Returns the Twig Environment used for rendering templates.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template file to be used for rendering.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Returns the currently set template filename.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Assigns a Vue component to the controller.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the AttributeBag used for template context data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Placeholder for initialization logic in subclasses.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Executed before rendering; can be overridden for pre-render setup.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the Vue template with the current context using Twig.

methods.name: postRender
methods.description: Executed after rendering; can be overridden for post-render actions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles the full process of pre-render, rendering, and post-render, returning a Response object.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns the parameters to be stored in the template context.

methods.name: getAssetsVersion
methods.description: Returns the assets version string, used for cache busting; reads from build file or timestamp.

methods.name: getSteps
methods.description: Returns the sequence of screens, distinguishing between installer and upgrader modes.

methods.name: getCurrentStep
methods.description: Determines the current step index based on the current screen and mode.
